entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, I need to make a return for an order I recently received.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. I can certainly help you with that today. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. It's for the Urban Commuter helmet.

Got it, thank you. I see the order here, delivered about 18 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a preference. Honestly, the color isn't what I was expecting from the photos online. My bike is a specific shade of blue, and this just clashes. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it.
I understand completely. Getting the right color is important. Let me just pull up our return policy for you.
Thank you. Safety is my top priority, of course, but I also want to like how my gear looks.

Of course. Okay, I've checked the policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and authorize this return for a full refund for you. I'll email you a return shipping label and instructions right now.

That's good news, thanks, Isaac. Now, I see here that the return shipping cost will be deducted from my refund. Since I'm planning to buy a different helmet from you right away, would it be possible to get that fee waived, or maybe a 15% discount code for my next purchase to offset it?

I appreciate you wanting to place another order with us. Let me see what I can do... Unfortunately, our policy is quite strict on this. For a return based on preference, like a color choice, we aren't able to offer additional credits or waive the shipping fee. The full refund for the item itself is the standard resolution.
I see. Is there any flexibility there? I'm a loyal customer, and a small gesture would go a long way. I'm just trying to find a solution that works for both of us.

I do understand your position, but my system is locked on this. I'm not authorized to generate goodwill credits for this type of return. I can confirm I have processed the return authorization, and as soon as we receive the helmet, you'll get your refund for the full product price. The email with the label should be in your inbox now.
Alright, I had to try. I appreciate you being straightforward. Thank you for processing the return so quickly.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again, Isaac.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
